svg.title: Exit ticket
svg.desc: Explain one daily and one yearly cycle with the correct motion, then name one limitation of a globe-and-lamp model. Mastery: The student distinguishes rotation, revolution and tilt, explains southern-hemisphere daylight and seasons causally, and evaluates a model without treating it as exact scale.
svg.text: • Explain one daily and one yearly cycle with the correct motion, then
name one limitation of a globe-and-lamp model.
• Mastery: The student distinguishes rotation, revolution and tilt,
explains southern-hemisphere daylight and seasons causally, and
evaluates a model without treating it as exact scale.
